g.text: One typed, audio, or image message per turn.
Every agent and sub-agent calls Claude through
an Anthropic LLM node. API key from server env.
Orchestrator. Reads questions. Writes nothing directly.
Built-in task tool delegates to seven specialist sub-agents.
Decomposes work, dispatches in parallel where safe,
Emits the final answer to the answers lane and back
to the UI via the response sink.
Builds its slice on a branch.
Writes via git write file tool.
All real disk writes go through
hello world, notes app, todo list.
as engineer one, two, and three.
Reviewer diffs. DevOps merges to main.
